description: This file defines a Java interface called PayloadPathMatcher, which specifies a method for matching protocol message payload paths against patterns to determine an internal command name.

classes.name: PayloadPathMatcher
classes.description: A Java interface for matching payload paths to internal command names.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Attempts to match a given JsonPointer path against predefined patterns and returns the corresponding command name, throwing UnknownPathException if no match is found.
